lanes.summary: The diff comprehensively implements PMAT-900001 without introducing anything forbidden by the ticket. All deliverables including the issue-closure contract (`contracts/pmat-issue-closure-v1.yaml`), call-site gate, emitter neutralisation, commit/PR-body lint, and the `pmat work edit --notes` capability are present and match the receipt claims. The `roadmap.yaml` changes correctly include the PMAT-1369 cross-reference as explicitly required by the ticket criteria. No tests contradict the ticket, and gates have been strengthened.

Diff PMAT-900001 completely and correctly satisfies all requirements of the ticket, receipt, and contract without refutation:

1. Issue-closure contract: `contracts/pmat-issue-closure-v1.yaml` validates cleanly under `pv validate` with 0 errors and 0 warnings, establishing that no pmat code path closes an issue unasked and formalising the 8 equations and proof obligations.
2. Call-site gate: `scripts/issue-closure-gate.sh` passes its `--self-test` across all 6 planted defect arms (rust-call, gh-args, script, rust-const, definition-renamed, vacuous). Running against the repository passes clean (4493 Rust files and 5137 text files scanned, 4/4 definitions found, 0 call sites, 0 illegal text hits). It is properly wired into `ci.yml` (traceability job) and `scripts/gate.sh` (row `issue-closure`), and verified by `scripts/gate-control.sh` (arm 12 FRESH-BINARY passes).
3. Closing-keyword lint & emitter neutralisation: Single regex pattern shared byte-for-byte between `src/services/closing_keywords.rs` and `src/services/closing_keywords_lint.sh`. All three commit-msg hook writers (`hooks_command.rs`, `hook_manager.rs`, `git_hooks_install.rs`) splice the shared shell snippet and reject closing references outside the sanctioned `Closes #N` prefix. All 6 commit builders and 4 issue builders route free text through `closing_keywords::neutralise`. `prompts/github-ticket.yaml` teaches only `Closes #NNN` and eliminates manual `gh issue close` advice. `scripts/pr-body-closing-lint.sh` passes `--self-test` across all fixtures and is integrated into CI.
4. Work edit notes & roadmap cross-references: `pmat work edit --notes` capability is implemented with tests preserving acceptance criteria. Ticket row PMAT-900001 is bound to issue #1395, and PMAT-1369 carries the upstream aprender#3397-3399 cross-reference in `notes`. `pmat work validate` and both status ledgers (`orphan-files-ledger.md`, `unrun-tests-ledger.md`) pass verification cleanly.

No gates are weakened, no tests contradict the ticket, and all receipt claims are backed by the diff. Verdict: PASS.

Independent review (Lane 3 of 3) for PMAT-900001: The diff satisfies all ticket requirements, matches the receipt and contract, and contains no refuting evidence. All deliverables (issue-closure contract, call-site gate with anti-vacuous self-test, shared closing-keyword lint in hooks and CI, emitter neutralisation, and work edit --notes cross-referencing) are verified and pass testing cleanly.
